entries.content: 视频：The Plain Bagel'应避免的投资错误'—追逐过去业绩、试图择时、没有分散、恐慌性抛售。关键：长期无聊的投资有效。从指数基金（VTI/VOO）开始、美元平均成本法、税收优惠账户最先。
動画：The Plain Bagel'避けるべき投資の間違い'—過去パフォーマンス追従、市場タイミング試み、分散しない、パニック売り。鍵：長期退屈な投資が機能。インデックスファンド（VTI/VOO）から開始、ドルコスト平均法、税制優遇口座が先。

Video: The Plain Bagel 'Investing mistakes to avoid' — chasing past performance, trying to time market, not diversifying, panic selling. Key: long-term boring investing works. Start index fund (VTI/VOO), dollar-cost averaging, tax-advantaged accounts first.

资产配置：股票（增长）+债券（稳定）+现金（流动性）+房地产（价值）。分散投资降低风险。Investor.gov：再平衡—保持目标比例。白大褂投资者：成本重要—1%资产管理费几十年显著累积，复利也适用于成本。
アセットアロケーション：株式（成長）+債券（安定）+現金（流動性）+不動産（価値）。分散投資リスク軽減。Investor.gov：リバランス—目標比率維持。White Coat Investor：コスト重要—1% AUMフィー何十年も significantly 累積、複利コストにも適用。

Asset allocation: stocks (growth) + bonds (stability) + cash (liquidity) + real estate (value). Diversification reduces risk. Investor.gov: rebalancing—maintain target ratio. White Coat Investor: cost matters—1% AUM fee accumulates significantly over decades, compounding applies to cost too.

Asset allocation: stocks (growth) + bonds (stability) + cash (liquidity) + real estate (value). Diversification giảm risk. Investor.gov: rebalancing—giữ целевой tỷ lệ. White Coat Investor: cost matters—1% AUM fee tích lũy lớn over decades, compounding applies to cả cost.
复利—利息生利息：$1000按10%年利→第一年$100利息，第二年$110（本息并算）。时间= money amplifier。尽早开始。伊利诺伊大学：在投资前偿还高息债务（>6%），应急基金3-6个月最先。
複利—利息が利息を生む：$1000 10%年利→1年目$100利息、2年目$110（元利併算）。時間＝お金増幅器。早期開始。Illinois U: 高金利負債（>6%）返済 investingの前に、緊急基金 3-6ヶ月分が先。

Compound interest — interest earns interest: $1000 at 10% →$100 year 1, $110 year 2 (interest on principal + interest). Time = money multiplier. Start early. Illinois U: pay down high-interest debt (>6%) before investing, emergency fund 3-6 months first.

Compound interest — tiền lãi sinh tiền lãi: $1000 at 10% →$100 năm 1, $110 năm 2 (lãi cả gốc lẫn lãi). Time = money multiplier. Start early. Illinois U: pay down high-interest debt (>6%) trước investing, emergency fund 3-6 months trước.
